name: personal-time-ledger-shells
description: Local-first time ledger for Android and desktop

scripts.desktop:package: npm run web:prepare && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-packager staging-desktop TimeLedger --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite
scripts.android:add: npm run web:prepare && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run web:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug-apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
